user_query: I'm a cryptocurrency enthusiast and I'm looking for comprehensive news coverage. Fetch news articles about Bitcoin and Ethereum from over 70 different websites. Also, provide me with the latest news from IEEE Spectrum to stay updated on the broader technology landscape.

TaskList.description: Fetch news articles about Bitcoin from multiple cryptocurrency news websites.
Fetch news articles about Ethereum from multiple cryptocurrency news websites.
Gather the latest news articles from IEEE Spectrum to cover broader technology topics.
Compile and aggregate the news articles fetched from Steps 1, 2, and 3 into a single report.
